ba-lm-578020.title: Pedestrian: white belt, straight legs
ba-lm-578020.summary: The Google car's pedestrian figure has a white belt, non-pointed shoes and straight legs. The belt is shared with Croatia, Portugal, Germany and Hungary; the straight legs and flat shoes narrow it further.

differs.how: Germany has the white belt but not the straight legs and flat shoes
Hungary has the white belt but not the straight legs and flat shoes

ba-lm-787131.title: Language: Cyrillic Serbian text
ba-lm-787131.summary: Cyrillic writing (улица for street) points to Serb-majority areas, mostly Republika Srpska. Serbian is also written in Latin script, and road signs often use both scripts everywhere.

ba-lm-787132.title: Language: Latin Bosnian/Croatian text
ba-lm-787132.summary: Latin-script text with 'ulica' for street. Bosnian and Croatian look almost identical, and Serbian is often written in Latin too, so this alone cannot pin down the country.
